title: PredefinedSentinelConfiguration
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M9. This message provides a predefined Sentinel configuration from the Predefined Configuration Libraries to the Sentinel Reconfiguration Deployment Unit. It contains the request context, the target Sentinel, the configuration payload, integrity information, and retrieval/validation status.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be predefinedSentinelConfiguration.

deploymentUnitId.description: Property. Identifier of the Sentinel Reconfiguration Deployment Unit receiving the predefined configuration.

source.description: Property. Source component or predefined configuration library providing the Sentinel configuration.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the predefined Sentinel configuration message was generated.

request.description: Property. Request context associated with the predefined Sentinel configuration response.

sentinelType.description: List of Sentinel types targeted by the configuration.

trigger.description: Structured value describing what triggered the configuration retrieval.

triggerType.description: Type of trigger that caused the configuration retrieval.

policyId.description: Identifier of the policy related to the trigger.

targetSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity targeted by this predefined configuration.

configurationPayload.description: Property. Payload containing the predefined Sentinel configuration to be applied or deployed.

version.description: Version of the predefined Sentinel configuration payload.

description.description: List of configuration update categories included in the payload.

sentinelModules.description: List of Sentinel modules to be configured or updated.

action.description: Action to be applied to the Sentinel module.

ruleset.description: Ruleset associated with the Sentinel module, when applicable.

key.description: Key or reference associated with the Sentinel module, when applicable.

firmware.description: Structured firmware information associated with the predefined Sentinel configuration.

required.description: Indicates whether firmware configuration or update is required.

version.description: Firmware version required by the configuration.

integrity.description: Property. Integrity information used to verify the predefined Sentinel configuration payload.

checksum.description: Checksum value of the configuration payload.

signature.description: Signature associated with the configuration payload.

status.description: Property. Retrieval and validation status of the predefined Sentinel configuration.

state.description: Current state of the configuration retrieval process.

validated.description: Indicates whether the configuration payload has been validated.

validationMethod.description: Method used to validate the configuration payload.
